name: mohammadhijjawi97__since-cutoff
description: Local stdio MCP server that reports what changed in a Python library's public API since a coding model's training cutoff (static griffe diff between the version at the cutoff and the pinned or latest version). No API key needed.
long_description: since-cutoff finds which APIs of your pinned Python dependencies changed after your coding model's training cutoff, and gives the agent short AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md notes from a static API diff without model calls or running untrusted code.

tools.name: project_changes
tools.description: Check every dependency of a Python project for API changes since a training cutoff. One call covers every direct dependency at the version the project pins.

tools.name: api_changes
tools.description: List the public API changes of one PyPI package since a model's training cutoff. Compares the newest release on or before the cutoff with the pinned or latest version.

tools.name: model_cutoff
tools.description: Look up a model's training cutoff date: library releases after it may be missing from its training data.
